capabilities: audit note properties against configured conventions
preview and selectively apply safe property fixes
undo the last applied batch of fixes
report type mismatches, invalid dates, and unresolved property links
check Base views and Base code blocks for template-folder exclusions
disambiguation: Not a general vault integrity checker; it validates note properties and Base views, not note bodies, attachments, or body links.
extras: The plugin's data.json stores original contents of the last fixed batch, so the author warns not to share it; Batches over 10 million characters are refused; mobile is untested; installation via BRAT is described as a beta plugin.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to validate property values against vault-specific rules or safely batch-fix property errors across notes.
summary: Property audit tool that checks note frontmatter against configurable vault conventions and applies previewed, undoable cleanup fixes.
